//: Emulator config for the test suites only (.bin/audit_unit).
Separate from firebase.json so tests never touch the dev emulator's persisted
.emulator_data/ — the rules suites clear Firestore between cases, which against the
dev stack would delete whatever you were working on.
Same rules files, different ports, no import/export.
//ports: Every port here is one below its firebase.json counterpart, hub and logging included.
The hub (4400), logging (4500) and Firestore's websocket (9150) are NOT derived from
the emulator ports — leave them at their defaults and a test run started while the dev
stack is up takes the dev emulators down with it, which looks like an unrelated
'socket hang up' in whatever was talking to them at the time.
